name: MsoAutomationSecurity
description: Specifies the security mode an application uses when programmatically opening files.

constants.name: msoAutomationSecurityLow
constants.description: Enables all macros. This is the default value when the application is started.

constants.name: msoAutomationSecurityByUI
constants.description: Uses the security setting specified in the Security dialog box.

constants.name: msoAutomationSecurityForceDisable
constants.description: Disables all macros in all files opened programmatically without showing any security alerts.
